statement: For 2026, the optional flat withholding rate on supplemental wages (which include equity compensation income such as NSO exercise spread) is 22%, and once an employee's supplemental wages during the calendar year exceed $1,000,000 the employer must withhold at 37% on the excess (Publication 15 (2026)).
caveat: Withholding is not the tax: the employee's actual liability is settled on the return, and the aggregate withholding method may apply instead of the optional flat rate. Rates are tied to statutory income tax rates and change; the 2026 figures carry their asOf date and must be re-verified each year.
